name: fixture
_note: TEST-ONLY theme (theme-system Wave 4, charter D24). NOT a shipped theme — it lives OUTSIDE design/themes/ so check.mjs Part F never characterizes it, and emit.mjs never renders it into a real artifact. Its only job is to prove the N-theme emission path: a second authored {bg,ink,accent} skin flows through derive() → themePalette() → a distinct [data-bp-theme="fixture"] block whose values differ from evergreen. Consumed exclusively by design/theme-emit.test.mjs.
